3_track_record.tenure: 14+ years in the Cheba Hut system. Timmons entered the brand in 2010 (acquired/operated Fort Collins, CO units), founded the Elevated umbrella in 2012-2013, and has expanded steadily; ~22nd location opened in Englewood, CO in Sept 2024.

unit_count_reconciliation.fdd_exhibit_c: Cheba Hut Investment Company (CO) operates 18 outlets; CHIC-Nevada operates 6 outlets => 24 system units attributed to Timmons. (One CHIC-Nevada line is listed under 'Unopened Outlets as of 12/31/2024', so the open NV count at year-end was lower than 6; the 24 figure includes a pipeline unit.)
unit_count_reconciliation.news_cross_check: Press (Franchise Times / Franchising.com / Fast Casual, 2024) reports ~21-22 open units (17 CO + 5 NV) — consistent with the FDD count net of the unopened NV unit.
unit_count_reconciliation.system_share: Single largest franchisee in a 73-franchised-unit system (Item 20 Table 3, 2024 year-end) => roughly a third of the franchised base. High concentration of the asset in one operator.

3_track_record.organic_vs_acquired: MIXED, mostly organic. Acquired the existing company-owned Fort Collins stores ~2012; secured CO/NV/KS development rights in 2019 and built new units organically thereafter. Reported sale of a prior Madison, WI location to another franchisee (explains a historical, benign transfer out).

closures_transfers_fdd_reconciliation.system_wide: Item 20 Tables 2 & 3 (2022-2024): 0 transfers to new owners, 0 terminations, 0 non-renewals system-wide across all states.
closures_transfers_fdd_reconciliation.ceased_other_reasons: Table 3 shows 'Ceased Operations - Other Reasons' = 1 in Colorado (2024), 1 in California (2022), 1 in Ohio (2023). CO is Timmons' home state (16->18 net in 2024 on +3 added, -1 ceased). The single 2024 Colorado closure CANNOT be definitively bound to Timmons from the FDD alone (the table is by state, not by franchisee), and no termination/non-renewal is recorded against anyone. Treated as a WATCH item, not a confirmed Timmons closure.

former_franchisee_listing_adjudication.observation: David Timmons / Cheba Hut Investment Company, LLC ALSO appears in Exhibit C's 'Former Franchisees' section (franchisees who 'transferred, terminated, cancelled, not renewed, or otherwise ceased' OR 'who has not communicated with us within ten weeks of the Issuance Date').
former_franchisee_listing_adjudication.adjudication: Most consistent with the BENIGN 'has not communicated within ten weeks' carve-out, NOT a termination. Rationale: (a) Item 20 records 0 terminations / 0 non-renewals / 0 transfers system-wide 2022-2024, so a real termination would contradict the franchisor's own change tables; (b) the SAME Timmons entity is simultaneously listed as an ACTIVE current franchisee operating 18 outlets and is named the largest franchisee in 2024 trade press; (c) the FDD's own narrative (Item 20, lines ~2630-2635) explicitly bundles non-communicators into the 'Former' list. The dual listing is therefore an artifact of the 10-week-no-response clause, not evidence of a franchise loss. WATCH-level, low concern.
former_franchisee_listing_adjudication.residual_risk: Cannot fully exclude that one specific CHIC unit closed/ceased in 2024 (ties to the CO 'ceased-other' = 1). A direct franchisor reference call would resolve whether any Timmons unit closed and why.

3_track_record.adverse_media: None found. Searches on 'David Timmons Cheba Hut' / 'Elevated Inc Cheba' return only positive growth coverage (Franchise Times, Denver Business Journal, Westword, Fast Casual). No bankruptcy, fraud, dispute, or distress reporting on the operator.
3_track_record.assessment: Credible, long-tenured, organically-grown operator with the largest position in the system and no adverse media. Two low-grade WATCH items: the unexplained single 2024 Colorado 'ceased-other' unit and the benign-looking 'Former Franchisee' dual-listing — both best closed with a franchisor reference call.

4_control_structure.sole_principal_question: NOT sole principal in the operating sense. David Timmons is owner/CEO and founder and the controlling principal. Kyle Archer is the second named principal — described in trade press as 'partner' and COO. Archer is a FORMER COMMERCIAL BANKER (and reportedly Timmons' former banker) who joined Elevated in 2020 as COO.
4_control_structure.implication_for_pcm: Day-to-day operations and likely some equity sit with Archer as well. Whether Archer holds an ownership stake (vs. an executive title) is NOT confirmable from public filings — CO does not publish member/officer ownership. The 'partner' framing means a co-investor/equity interest is plausible. PCM should obtain the Elevated Inc. / CHIC operating agreements and cap table to confirm WHO controls and economically owns the asset it is buying into.
4_control_structure.multi_brand_bandwidth: Timmons/Archer also build SkinnyFATS (separate fast-casual brand, via Elevated SF Inc., expanding in CO since 2023) plus Elevated Meats. Management attention and capital are split across multiple brands — a bandwidth/capital-allocation consideration for a Cheba-Hut-specific investment, not a red flag.
4_control_structure.two_entity_structure_rationale: CHIC (CO) and CHIC-Nevada (separate LLC) is standard multi-state franchise structuring — a per-state operating entity isolates liability, aligns to state development agreements (CO and NV rights were granted separately in 2019), and simplifies state licensing/tax. Both trace to Timmons/Elevated. No concealment signal.

verdict.one_line: David Timmons / Elevated Inc. is a credible, 14-year, organically-grown operator — the genuine single largest Cheba Hut franchisee (~24 units, ~1/3 of the system), federal-litigation-clean (the 45 'David Timmons' dockets are out-of-region homonyms; zero in CO/NV courts), OFAC-clean, CO entities in good standing — with NO material red flags; back-him-able subject to three confirmable WATCH items.
watch_flags: Co-principal Kyle Archer (COO/'partner', ex-banker, joined 2020): confirm his ownership stake and control via the Elevated/CHIC operating agreement + cap table before assuming Timmons is the sole economic owner of the PCM asset.

NV registration UNVERIFIABLE this pass: confirm 'CHIC - Nevada, LLC' good-standing via the gated NV SilverFlume portal (or order a NV status certificate) — operation is corroborated, registration is not.

FDD wrinkles: (a) one unexplained 2024 Colorado 'Ceased Operations - Other Reasons' unit and (b) Timmons' simultaneous 'Former Franchisee' listing (adjudicated as the benign 10-week-no-response clause, consistent with 0 system terminations) — close both with a direct franchisor reference call.

Minor: official CO record for the lead entity is 'Cheba Hut Investment Company, Inc.' while the FDD says 'LLC' (same entity by address/agent); multi-brand bandwidth split across SkinnyFATS + Elevated Meats.
not_flags_explicitly_cleared: 319 Iowa area code: benign (Iowa background; operating nexus Denver+Las Vegas fully corroborated).
45 David Timmons federal dockets: 100% common-name false positives, zero in the operator's CO/NV nexus.
Two-entity CO+NV structure: standard multi-state franchise liability/development structuring, not concealment.
verdict.escalation_scope: State courts (CO/NV), full PACER, UCC liens, and NV SilverFlume status remain a paid/manual escalation. Federal-clean is necessary, not sufficient.
